lookup.app: SELECT id FROM applications WHERE name = 'SMOKE {{run}} Registered' AND location_id = 1 AND owner_department_id = 4

lookup.ep: SELECT id FROM application_endpoints WHERE application_id = {{app}} AND name = 'Records MCP' AND kind = 'mcp'

lookup.gone: SELECT 'yes' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM application_endpoints WHERE id = {{ep}} AND status = 'active')
